g.text: Two reasoning modes under one roof
Route by output shape: prose → LLM · typed decision → System One
prose / string out → you parse & validate
best at: copy, narrative, reason codes, SQL
parallel sampling — all values at once
best at: classify, route, score, match, rerank
pgvector does semantic recall for both · everything sits behind customer360-agent
System One latency / cost / calibration numbers are single-source vendor claims — adopt only after the calibration POC.
